findings.fix: Remove the pattern attribute or change it to `pattern="[0-9\s\-\+]*"` to allow formatted numbers.
findings.violation: The pattern allows only digits, which excludes common phone number formatting like spaces, dashes, or international plus signs.
The field uses type="text" instead of type="url", so the browser won't validate the URL format.

findings.evidence: Label says "(8 digits)" but the input has no validation pattern
findings.violation: There is no pattern validation to enforce the documented 8-digit requirement.

findings.fix: Add validation such as `pattern="[0-9]+"` or appropriate minlength/maxlength attributes.
findings.violation: The account number field has no validation constraints despite likely needing a specific format.
The size attribute is too restrictive since postal codes vary by country (5-10+ characters), and size doesn't actually constrain input length.
The select element has no name attribute, so the selected value won't be submitted with the form data.

findings.evidence: Two fields labeled "Full name" (name="full_name") and "Your name" (name="legal_name")
findings.fix: Remove one of the duplicate name fields or clarify why both are needed.
findings.violation: The form collects the user's name twice with different field names, which is confusing and redundant.

findings.fix: Move inline styles to a `<style>` block in the head or external stylesheet.
findings.violation: Inline styles are scattered throughout the document instead of being in a style block or external CSS.

findings.evidence: `<input id="contacttime-input" name="contact_time" type="text" required="">` with label having `style="display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px"`
findings.fix: Change `type="text"` to `type="time"` and move the label's style to a stylesheet.
findings.violation: The field uses type="text" instead of type="time", and the label has inline styles instead of being in a stylesheet.

findings.fix: Either remove the button if unused, or add an onclick handler and move the styles to a stylesheet.
findings.violation: The button has inline styles and type="button" but no onclick handler or purpose, making it non-functional.

findings.evidence: Three select elements with `id="dob-day-select"`, `id="dob-month-select"`, `id="dob-year-select"` but no name attributes
findings.fix: Add name attributes to each select: `name="dob_day"`, `name="dob_month"`, and `name="dob_year"`.
findings.location: row-dob fieldset, date of birth selects
findings.violation: The date selects lack name attributes, so the date of birth data won't be submitted with the form.

findings.evidence: Day dropdown allows 1-31, all 12 months, and years 1950-2009 without dependency
